sloka: स पुत्रम् मूर्ध्नि उपाघ्राय राजा दशरथः तदा ।ददौ कुशिक पुत्राय सुप्रीतेन अंतरात्मना ॥१-२२-३॥
transliteration: sa putram mūrdhni upāghrāya rājā daśarathaḥ tadā ।dadau kuśika putrāya suprītena aṁtarātmanā ॥1-22-3॥

translations.english: Rama was given farewell by his parents with recitation of mantras (for securing prosperity and averting evils). Priest Vasishta sanctified him with mantras Dasaratha kissed his son on the forehead and delivered him to the care of Viswamitra, with a heart full of cheer.
translations.hindi: अच्छा, यदि आपकी यही इच्छा है तो, लो में यह चला | आप अपनी प्रतिज्ञा मेट कर भाई-बन्धुओं सहित प्रसन्न रहिये
